## Why visit

The Grapes on Roscoe Street is the one to target for smaller-brewery cask, a convivial corner-pub atmosphere and jazz. The old brewery lettering outside and the compact rooms supply continuity, while a later extension and raised patio make it more capacious than its nickname suggests. It complements Roscoe Head especially well: the two pubs are close but offer different moods. Build it into a route when you want to hear some music or compare regional brewers without trekking to an industrial taproom.

## Beer

CAMRA describes handpumps mainly serving local and regional smaller breweries. CAMRA names Colbier and Neptune as typical changing cask producers; neither is a permanent fixture.
